verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software tools with UIs: questionnaire-driven SCC and Term Sheet generators built on Contract Express, plus a HighQ-hosted deal room. So asking whether those tools have API parity is a fair question. The evidence documents no public API at all, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The Docusign integration is an adjacent execution feature, not an API that can do what the UI does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
